content_brief.title: What homeowners should verify before choosing a heat pump
content_brief.angle: Turn incentive interest into a practical eligibility checklist.
key_points: Confirm equipment eligibility before quoting a credit.
Separate federal guidance from utility-specific programs.

faqs.question: Does every heat pump qualify for an incentive?
faqs.answer: No. Eligibility depends on the equipment, household, location, installation date, and the specific program being used. Homeowners should verify current requirements with the authoritative program source before treating any incentive as guaranteed, and contractors should avoid quoting a universal amount until the exact system and customer circumstances have been checked.

client_alert.summary: Interest is actionable, but marketing copy should avoid universal eligibility claims.
